narration:1:1610431002:1.text: In the viewing area, Cyran is carefully observing the students' actions with a strange smile on his face.

say:3:1610431003:1.text: Cyran, your expression is far more severe than in your student days. You look like you've been weaned on lemon juice and paperwork! I take it being the Chief Court Mage isn't all giggles and sparkles.
say:3:1610431003:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷，你的表情可比学生时代凝重多了，连笑都成了一种...

say:4:1610431004:1.text: On the contrary, my dear Headmaster. My disposition is perfectly sunny. In fact, observing the new crop of students has been rather... delightful.
say:4:1610431004:1.source_cn: 你误会了，校长先生，我的心情其实很愉快。尤其是在见到这...

say:5:1610431005:1.text: I assume you've also noticed that the remarkable <style="stress"><player_name></style> bears a striking resemblance to a certain... acquaintance of ours.

say:5:1610431005:1.female: I assume you've also noticed that the remarkable <style="stress"><player_name></style> bears a striking resemblance to a certain... acquaintance of ours.

say:6:1610431006:1.text: Aha! I just knew your thoughts would drift to Merlin! Even now, the Lyceum's finest casts quite the long shadow, doesn't he?
say:6:1610431006:1.source_cn: 哎呀，我就知道你忘不了梅林——莱希拉姆有史以来最出色的...

say:6:1610431006:1.female: Aha! I just knew your thoughts would drift to Merlin! Even now, the Lyceum's finest casts quite the long shadow, doesn't she?

say:7:1610431007:1.text: Oh, the memories! You two were the absolute pride of the school in your time, shining every bit as brightly as Gervan and Cassadee do today.
say:7:1610431007:1.source_cn: 想当初，你们可是学校里最出色耀眼的两个人，就像现在的格...
say:7:1610431007:1.male: Oh, the memories! You two were the absolute pride of the school in your time, shining every bit as brightly as Gervan and Cassadee do today.

say:8:1610431008:1.text: The pangs of nostalgia for a former comrade. Hahaha! It's no surprise you're projecting your feelings of longing onto the new generation.
say:8:1610431008:1.source_cn: 你一定很想念你的老朋友，哈哈哈哈，将思念之情投射在新生...
say:8:1610431008:1.male: The pangs of nostalgia for a former comrade. Hahaha! It's no surprise you're projecting your feelings of longing onto the new generation.

say:9:1610431009:1.text: Despite the chasm between the two, I quite see how one might spy a common thread.
say:9:1610431009:1.source_cn: 尽管他们区别甚多，但你觉得他们有相像之处，我也可以理解。
say:9:1610431009:1.male: Despite the chasm between the two, I quite see how one might spy a common thread.
say:9:1610431009:1.female: Despite the chasm between the two, I quite see how one might spy a common thread.

say:10:1610431010:1.text: The bonds forged in these halls... what a precious thing. It reminds me of my own dearest friend from my youth...
say:10:1610431010:1.source_cn: 学生时代的友谊啊……真是令人怀念。在我上学的时候，也有...

say:12:1610431012:1.text: Yes, yes, quite right! Pay an old man no mind. There's no point daydreaming about yesterday when the future is yet to be written.
say:12:1610431012:1.source_cn: 哦。哦哦哦，你说得对，不要学我，别总是陷入回忆，要往后看。

say:13:1610431013:1.text: Goodness me, my yapping has run away with me again! We've missed half the show. Shush now, and let the students' magic do the talking!
say:13:1610431013:1.source_cn: 咳，光顾着聊天了，错过了不少学生的精彩表现。我们还是安...
